blocker.detail: The available GitHub write surface in this run does not expose a local/ChatGPT-file parameter for transferring generated binary image bytes directly into a repository path. UTF-8 create/update actions can write text, but the delivery protocol requires actual image bytes saved and read back before an asset may be called STAGED. The worker deliberately did not downgrade the art to a text-only geometric substitute, external URL, or promotional sheet and did not claim a sandbox/local file as repository delivery.
blocker.needed: A supported authorized binary-file-to-GitHub write/import path that can accept the generated file reference or local bytes and allow exact hash readback. Once available, upload the existing three generated originals/card derivatives rather than regenerate them.

nextAction: On the next cycle, re-check whether workstream 15/08 has established the supported binary import path. If yes, stage desks-2..4 first, read back exact hashes, then mark them READY_FOR_REVIEW for reviewer 05.
